title: חנן בן אבשלום

paragraphs: Chanan ben Avshalom and Admon (see there): beginning of Shenei Dayyanei Gezerot, mishnayot 1 and 2. The sons of high priests and R. Dosa ben Harkinas disagreed with him. Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai said, “Chanan spoke well”: Ketubot 105, 107b; Nedarim 33b. In the Temple period. Tosafot at the end of HaMemunneh says Rabbenu Tam reads ben Avishalom.
